source_text: \subsection{{Example: grad, curl, and div and their adjoints}}\label{sec:vector-operators-adjoints}
translated_text: \subsection{{Example: grad, curl 和 div 及其伴随}}\label{sec:vector-operators-adjoints}

source_text: {In this section we consider the three vector calculus operators which enter the de Rham complex, showing how to view them as closed unbounded operators on Hilbert space, and deriving their basic properties in that framework.}
translated_text: {本节考虑 de Rham 复形中的三个向量微积分算子, 说明如何将它们视为 Hilbert 空间上的闭无界算子, 并在这一框架下推导其基本性质.}

source_text:
{Let $\Omega$ denote a bounded domain in $\mathbb R^n$. We start by considering the unbounded operator from $L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$ to $L^2(\Omega)$ with domain $C_0^\infty(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$ given by $\phi\mapsto-\operatorname{div}\phi$ for $\phi\in C_0^\infty(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$. We shall write this operator as $(-\operatorname{div},C_0^\infty)$ to make clear its domain. Although it is not a closed operator, it is clearly densely defined, so its adjoint $(-\operatorname{div},C_0^\infty)^*$ is a closed operator $L^2(\Omega)\to L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$. By definition, a real-valued function $u$ on $\Omega$ belongs to the domain of this adjoint if it belongs to $L^2(\Omega)$ and there exists a vector field $v$ in $L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$ for which}
\[
-\int_\Omega u\operatorname{div}\phi\,dx=\int_\Omega v\cdot\phi\,dx,\qquad\phi\in C_0^\infty(\Omega;\mathbb R^n).
\]
translated_text:
{设 $\Omega$ 表示 $\mathbb R^n$ 中的有界区域. 先考虑从 $L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$ 到 $L^2(\Omega)$ 的无界算子, 其定义域为 $C_0^\infty(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$, 对 $\phi\in C_0^\infty(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$, 由 $\phi\mapsto-\operatorname{div}\phi$ 给出. 为明确其定义域, 将此算子记为 $(-\operatorname{div},C_0^\infty)$. 尽管它不是闭算子, 但显然稠密定义, 故其伴随 $(-\operatorname{div},C_0^\infty)^*$ 是闭算子 $L^2(\Omega)\to L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$. 按定义, $\Omega$ 上的实值函数 $u$ 属于该伴随的定义域, 是指它属于 $L^2(\Omega)$, 且存在 $L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^n)$ 中的向量场 $v$, 使得}
\[
-\int_\Omega u\operatorname{div}\phi\,dx=\int_\Omega v\cdot\phi\,dx,\qquad\phi\in C_0^\infty(\Omega;\mathbb R^n).
\]

source_text: {Third, the kernel of the trace operator is the space $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$, defined as the closure of $C_0^\infty(\Omega)$ in $H^1(\Omega)$. See [\BookNumber{41}, Section 5.5, Theorem 2]. Knowing both the range and the kernel of the trace operator acting on $H^1(\Omega)$, we can use duality to characterize the functionals on $H^1(\Omega)$ which vanish on the kernel $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$. The following result is elementary.}
translated_text: {第三, 迹算子的核为空间 $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$, 它定义为 $C_0^\infty(\Omega)$ 在 $H^1(\Omega)$ 中的闭包. 见 [\BookNumber{41}, Section 5.5, Theorem 2]. 已知作用于 $H^1(\Omega)$ 的迹算子的像与核后, 便可利用对偶刻画那些在核 $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ 上为零的 $H^1(\Omega)$ 上的泛函. 下述结论是初等的.}

source_text: {Applying this lemma with $\gamma$ equal to the trace operator $\operatorname{tr}:H^1(\Omega)\to H^{1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ and defining $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ as the dual space of $H^{1/2}(\partial\Omega)$, we obtain the following characterization.}
translated_text: {将此引理用于 $\gamma$ 等于迹算子 $\operatorname{tr}:H^1(\Omega)\to H^{1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ 的情形, 并将 $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ 定义为 $H^{1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ 的对偶空间, 得到下述刻画.}

source_text:
{Moreover,}
\[
\|\gamma_n w\|_{-1/2,\partial\Omega}=\sup_u\frac{\int u\operatorname{div}w\,dx+\int\operatorname{grad}u\cdot w\,dx}{\|u\|_{1,\Omega}}\leq\|w\|_{H(\operatorname{div})}.
\]
translated_text:
{此外,}
\[
\|\gamma_n w\|_{-1/2,\partial\Omega}=\sup_u\frac{\int u\operatorname{div}w\,dx+\int\operatorname{grad}u\cdot w\,dx}{\|u\|_{1,\Omega}}\leq\|w\|_{H(\operatorname{div})}.
\]

source_text:
{We are now able to compute the adjoint of the gradient operator with domain $H^1$. For this, define}
\[
\mathring H(\operatorname{div})=\{\,w\in H(\operatorname{div})\mid\gamma_n w=0\,\}.
\]
translated_text:
{现在可以计算定义域为 $H^1$ 的梯度算子的伴随. 为此, 定义}
\[
\mathring H(\operatorname{div})=\{\,w\in H(\operatorname{div})\mid\gamma_n w=0\,\}.
\]

source_text: {We next show that the normal trace operator maps $H(\operatorname{div})$ not only into $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$ but onto.}
translated_text: {接下来证明, 法向迹算子不仅将 $H(\operatorname{div})$ 映入 $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega)$, 而且映满该空间.}

source_text: {Using this, we can argue exactly as in the proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:gradient-adjoint-zero-normal}, to prove the following result, which establishes the adjoint of the divergence operator.}
translated_text: {利用这一点, 可完全按照 Theorem~\ref{thm:gradient-adjoint-zero-normal} 证明中的论证, 证明下述结论, 从而确定散度算子的伴随.}

source_text: {Since $T^{**}=T$ for a closed densely defined operator, from Theorems~\ref{thm:gradient-adjoint-zero-normal} and \ref{thm:divergence-adjoint-zero-trace} we can read off two more adjoints.}
translated_text: {由于对闭的稠密定义算子有 $T^{**}=T$, 从 Theorems~\ref{thm:gradient-adjoint-zero-normal} 和 \ref{thm:divergence-adjoint-zero-trace} 可直接读出另外两个伴随.}

source_text: {Next we verify that all of these operators have closed range. For $(\operatorname{div},H(\operatorname{div}))$ this is clear, since in fact $\operatorname{div}H(\operatorname{div})=L^2$, as can be seen by writing $f\in L^2$ as $\Delta u=\operatorname{div}\operatorname{grad}u$ for some $u\in H^1$. If $\int f\,dx=0$, then we can choose $u$ satisfying the Neumann condition $\operatorname{grad}u\cdot n=0$, and so $f\in\operatorname{div}\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$. Thus the range $\operatorname{div}\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$ has codimension $1$ in $L^2$, and so this is closed as well, by Theorem~\ref{thm:finite-codimension-closed-range}. The closed range theorem then implies that the adjoints of these two maps, namely, $(\operatorname{grad},\mathring H^1)$ and $(\operatorname{grad},H^1)$, both have closed range as well.}
translated_text: {下面验证这些算子的像空间全都是闭的. 对 $(\operatorname{div},H(\operatorname{div}))$, 这一点很明显, 因为实际上 $\operatorname{div}H(\operatorname{div})=L^2$: 将 $f\in L^2$ 写成某个 $u\in H^1$ 的 $\Delta u=\operatorname{div}\operatorname{grad}u$ 即可看出. 若 $\int f\,dx=0$, 则可选取 $u$ 满足 Neumann 条件 $\operatorname{grad}u\cdot n=0$, 从而 $f\in\operatorname{div}\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$. 因此像空间 $\operatorname{div}\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$ 在 $L^2$ 中的余维为 $1$, 所以由 Theorem~\ref{thm:finite-codimension-closed-range}, 它也是闭的. 闭值域定理进而表明这两个映射的伴随, 即 $(\operatorname{grad},\mathring H^1)$ 和 $(\operatorname{grad},H^1)$, 也都具有闭像空间.}

source_text: {Comparing with \eqref{eq:curl-classical-green} we see that we have extended the \emph{tangential trace operator} $\gamma_\tau v:=v|_{\partial\Omega}\times n$ to a bounded linear map on $H(\operatorname{curl})$ with range belonging to the Sobolev space of $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega;\mathbb R^3)$ of vector fields on $\partial\Omega$, and so we have established the analogue of Theorem~\ref{thm:normal-trace-extension} for $H(\operatorname{curl})$.}
translated_text: {与 \eqref{eq:curl-classical-green} 比较可见, 我们已将\emph{切向迹算子} $\gamma_\tau v:=v|_{\partial\Omega}\times n$ 延拓为 $H(\operatorname{curl})$ 上的有界线性映射, 其像属于 $\partial\Omega$ 上向量场的 Sobolev 空间 $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega;\mathbb R^3)$. 因而得到了 $H(\operatorname{curl})$ 的相应于 Theorem~\ref{thm:normal-trace-extension} 的结论.}

source_text: {Note, however, that the trace operator $\gamma_\tau$ is not onto $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega;\mathbb R^3)$, i.e., the analogue of Theorem~\ref{thm:normal-trace-surjective} does not hold. For one thing, $\gamma_\tau w$ is always a tangential vector field. This is clear at least if $v$ and $\partial\Omega$ are smooth, while the precise way to define this in the case of a merely Lipschitz boundary is subtle. There are further restrictions on the range of $\gamma_\tau$ as well. See [\BookNumber{25}, \BookNumber{26}] for details.}
translated_text: {然而须注意, 迹算子 $\gamma_\tau$ 并不映满 $H^{-1/2}(\partial\Omega;\mathbb R^3)$, 即相应于 Theorem~\ref{thm:normal-trace-surjective} 的结论不成立. 首先, $\gamma_\tau w$ 总是切向向量场. 至少在 $v$ 和 $\partial\Omega$ 光滑时, 这一点很清楚, 而在边界仅为 Lipschitz 的情形, 如何精确定义这一点却很微妙. $\gamma_\tau$ 的像还受到其他限制. 详情参见 [\BookNumber{25}, \BookNumber{26}].}

source_text: {In Section~\ref{sec:l2-de-rham-complex} we show that the range $\operatorname{curl}H(\operatorname{curl})$ is closed.}
translated_text: {在 Section~\ref{sec:l2-de-rham-complex} 中, 我们将证明像空间 $\operatorname{curl}H(\operatorname{curl})$ 是闭的.}

source_text: {An \emph{(unbounded) operator} from one Hilbert space $X$ to another $Y$ is a linear operator mapping its domain $D(T)$, a subspace of $X$, into $Y$. The domain need not be closed in $X$ and the operator need not be bounded, but usually we require that the operator be \emph{densely defined}, i.e., that $D(T)$ is dense in $X$.}
translated_text: {从 Hilbert 空间 $X$ 到另一个空间 $Y$ 的\emph{(无界) 算子}, 是将其定义域 $D(T)$ (它是 $X$ 的子空间) 映入 $Y$ 的线性算子. 定义域不必在 $X$ 中闭, 算子也不必有界, 但通常要求算子\emph{稠密定义}, 即 $D(T)$ 在 $X$ 中稠密.}

source_text: {An operator is \emph{closed} if its graph is closed in $X\times Y$ or, equivalently, if $D(T)$ is complete when furnished with the \emph{graph norm}. An everywhere defined operator is closed if and only if it is bounded.}
translated_text: {若算子的图在 $X\times Y$ 中闭, 或等价地, $D(T)$ 配备\emph{图范数}后完备, 则称该算子是\emph{闭的}. 处处有定义的算子是闭的当且仅当它有界.}

source_text: {A densely defined operator $T$ from $X$ to $Y$ gives rise to an adjoint operator $T^*$ from $Y$ to $X$. The adjoint $T^*$ is always closed. If $T$ is closed, then $T^*$ is also densely defined, and, in this case, $T^{**}=T$.}
translated_text: {从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的稠密定义算子 $T$ 产生从 $Y$ 到 $X$ 的伴随算子 $T^*$. 伴随 $T^*$ 总是闭的. 若 $T$ 是闭的, 则 $T^*$ 也稠密定义, 并且此时 $T^{**}=T$.}

source_text: {The range of a closed, densely defined linear operator $X\to Y$ need not be a closed subspace, but the range of $T$ is closed in $Y$ if and only if the range of $T^*$ is closed in $X$. If $\dim Y/\mathcal R(T)<\infty$, then $T$ has closed range. If the inclusion $D(T)\subset X$ is compact, then $T$ has closed range.}
translated_text: {闭的稠密定义线性算子 $X\to Y$ 的像空间不一定是闭子空间, 但 $T$ 的像空间在 $Y$ 中闭当且仅当 $T^*$ 的像空间在 $X$ 中闭. 若 $\dim Y/\mathcal R(T)<\infty$, 则 $T$ 具有闭像空间. 若包含映射 $D(T)\subset X$ 是紧的, 则 $T$ 具有闭像空间.}

source_text:
{On a bounded domain in $\mathbb R^3$ with Lipschitz boundary, the operators grad, curl, and div may be viewed as unbounded operators on $L^2$ (scalars or vectors), with domains $H^1$, $H(\operatorname{curl})$, $H(\operatorname{div})$, respectively. They are densely defined, closed, and have closed ranges. Their adjoints are $-\operatorname{div}$, $\operatorname{curl}$, and $-\operatorname{grad}$ with domains $\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$, $\mathring H(\operatorname{curl})$, and $\mathring H^1$, respectively.}
\end{tcolorbox}
translated_text:
{在 $\mathbb R^3$ 中具有 Lipschitz 边界的有界区域上, 算子 grad, curl 和 div 可视为 $L^2$ (标量或向量) 上的无界算子, 定义域分别为 $H^1$, $H(\operatorname{curl})$ 和 $H(\operatorname{div})$. 它们稠密定义, 闭, 且具有闭像空间. 它们的伴随分别为 $-\operatorname{div}$, $\operatorname{curl}$ 和 $-\operatorname{grad}$, 定义域分别为 $\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$, $\mathring H(\operatorname{curl})$ 和 $\mathring H^1$.}
\end{tcolorbox}
